title: Prevent Mac from sleeping and enable auto-restart
summary: Configure the Mac to never go to sleep and to automatically restart after a power failure or system freeze. Useful for servers or long-running tasks.

steps.explain: Disable sleep mode and enable automatic restart on power failure or kernel panic.

rollback.explain: Re-enable sleep mode and disable automatic restarts to return to default behavior.

warnings: Disabling sleep increases power consumption and heat generation.
